cases.title: Chooses the most occupied sector

expected_feedback.diagnosis: The selection rule prefers the sector with the greatest obstacle density rather than a navigable low-density sector near the goal direction.
debugging_steps: State what a high histogram value represents.
Identify which values correspond to safer directions.
Apply the goal-direction rule only among eligible sectors.
expected_feedback.socratic_question: In a VFH histogram, does a larger density describe a clearer or more obstructed direction?

hint_ladder.hint: Interpret the meaning of a high histogram value before choosing an index.
Safe candidates should satisfy the assignment's low-density condition.
Choose among safe candidates using closeness to the goal direction.

cases.title: Stores the selected angle as the histogram value

debugging_steps: Read the angle and density from their respective arrays at that index.
Verify the units and meaning of both outputs.
expected_feedback.socratic_question: What does each output represent, and should those two quantities have the same unit?

hint_ladder.hint: Compare the meanings of the two requested output variables.
Both outputs come from the same chosen index but from different arrays or quantities.
Read the histogram value at the selected sector rather than copying its angle.
